notes.firstLaunch: The first Play opens Prism Launcher once: sign in with the Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. Prism then downloads Minecraft and Java (a few minutes) and the game starts. Create a single-player Survival world: the mod builds Level 0 from your copy of Escape the Backrooms (a few seconds, the first time only) and puts you in it. Right click with the flashlight switches it on and off; right click with the almond water drinks it. Escape the Backrooms must be installed on Steam: the level, the Bacteria, the items and the sounds are read from your copy.
